cim: RBA webinar to help baking and pastry educators navigate Artificial Intelligence responsibly
cim_eredeti: RBA webinar to help baking and pastry educators navigate Artificial Intelligence responsibly
szoveg_eredeti:
As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly accessible to educators, questions about its appropriate role in hands-on culinary instruction are gaining importance.

On Wednesday, December 9 from 6-7 pm EST, the Retail Bakers of America (RBA) will present Baking & AI: Getting Started Responsibly, a free virtual webinar designed to help baking and pastry educators who are new to artificial intelligence explore practical applications of it while maintaining instructional integrity.

The session will be presented by Chef Kimberly Houston, instructional designer, education strategist, and founder of Mise & Method Education, alongside Tasha Mathis, founder of ATYP Education and Consulting, LLC, and IT Training Coordinator at Morehouse College.

Participants will explore opportunities to use AI for lesson planning, instructional resource development, and administrative tasks. The webinar will also address considerations surrounding student privacy, accuracy, academic integrity, and professional judgment.

The session includes an introductory prompting framework educators can use to begin developing AI-assisted teaching resources.

"Technology should support the learning experience, not replace the expertise of the educator," says Kimberly Houston. "Our goal is to help instructors make informed decisions about how AI fits into their classrooms while preserving the hands-on skills and critical thinking that culinary education requires."

The virtual event is free and open to both RBA members and non-members. Registration and additional information can be found here.

Chef Saif Manna of Manna Bakery has mastered the art of a standout cookie and is offering his expert advice to help bakers elevate their holiday treats.
